analysis: five-node nonlinear steady-state thermal resistance screening
recommended_disposition: instrumented bench/phantom characterization; thermal path and operating envelope unresolved
limitations: The parameter-corner range is a sensitivity envelope, not a probability interval or guaranteed temperature bound. Independent extrema for electronics and pack heat conservatively remove electrical correlations.
Nodes are average temperatures; localized cell, IC, sleeve and contact hotspots are unresolved.

No thermal-via/trace/airflow mesh, measured material properties or human perfusion model is present. Nylon ribs, fasteners and wire conduction are omitted; no intentional low-resistance heat path is specified. Omitted conduction may cool electronics and warm the base; the ranges do not bound localized temperatures.
The 34C/R15 phantom is a defined comparison fixture, not a validated model of human skin.
Charging steady-state values describe requested charging before cutoff; physical CE inhibition changes heat generation and may cycle.
Pack internal resistance, entropic heat, standby draw, charger efficiency, optical/RF heat escape and static-air boundary are unmeasured.
Insulated clothing, direct sun, motion, sweat and hand contact change boundary conditions; these are not inferred from the sampled natural-convection range.
No transient warmup/cutoff time is claimed; measured thermal capacitance/NTC lag is needed.
